cases.cygnus-x1: 天鹅座 X-1 · 恒星与黑洞

actions.systems: 先看完整阵容，再用「同尺对照」看轨道有多紧凑；点行星或播放20天。
actions.galaxies: 先找银河的薄盘，再和M87一起转到侧面，比较厚薄。
actions.sky: 先看地面夜空，再切换视线；用「星座的远近」观察同一组星。
actions.homes: 沿太阳系、银河系、星系群到可观测范围，找清我们的结构地址。
actions.zoom: 按「开始拉远」或拖动距离尺；想从太阳出发，在「设置」里切换。

caseActions.milky-way: 转到侧面，找找太阳在薄盘里的位置。
caseActions.galaxy-comparison: 点「侧面看银河」，比较银河薄盘与M87恒星体的厚度。
caseActions.trappist-1: 先看完整阵容，再用「同尺对照」看轨道有多紧凑；点行星或播放20天。
caseActions.sky: 先看「地面夜空」，再切换「沿盘面看」；移动镜头看这条光带的来处。
caseActions.orion: 点选一颗亮星，再移动观察位置，看同一认星图案怎样显出远近。
caseActions.spiral: 转动M31寻找旋臂，再用夜空入口对应它在天空中的方向。
caseActions.elliptical: 转到不同方向，看看平滑的恒星体怎样保持厚度。
caseActions.irregular: 找到弥散星光，再看偏在一旁的亮区。
caseActions.star-cluster: 找到银晕星团，对照同一对象的放大图。
caseActions.local-group: 找到银河、仙女座和三角座；这里的小标记代表整座星系。
caseActions.kepler-16: 追踪双恒星与已知环双星行星。
caseActions.cygnus-x1: 区分恒星、黑洞和发光的热气体。

en.caseLabel: What to explore in this question

cases.cygnus-x1: Cygnus X-1 · star and black hole

actions.systems: Start with whole families, compare orbits on the same ruler, select planets or play 20 days.
actions.galaxies: Find the Milky Way disk, then turn it and M87 edge-on to compare thickness.
actions.sky: Start with the ground sky, change sightlines, then explore the same constellation from the side.
actions.homes: Follow our structural address from the Solar System through galaxies to the observable region.
actions.zoom: Play or scrub the distance scale. To start from the Sun, change the origin in Settings.

caseActions.milky-way: Turn edge-on and find the Sun inside the thin disk.
caseActions.galaxy-comparison: Choose Milky Way edge-on and compare its thin disk with the thicker M87 volume.
caseActions.trappist-1: Start with whole families, compare orbits on the same ruler, select planets or play 20 days.
caseActions.sky: Start with Earth sky, switch to Along the disk, then move the camera to trace the band to its structure.
caseActions.orion: Select a bright star, then move the observer to reveal depths behind the same sky pattern.
caseActions.spiral: Turn M31 to find its arms, then use the sky link to locate its direction.
caseActions.elliptical: Turn to different directions and see how the smooth stellar body retains thickness.
caseActions.irregular: Find diffuse stars and bright young regions.
caseActions.star-cluster: Locate the halo cluster; compare its close-up.
caseActions.local-group: Find the Milky Way, Andromeda and Triangulum; small locators here stand for whole galaxies.
caseActions.kepler-16: Follow two stars and their known circumbinary planet.
caseActions.cygnus-x1: Distinguish the star, black hole and glowing hot gas.
